nodes.label: B-073: R66 Frozen-Source Intake Correction Guide
nodes.description: Handoff status: Answered, Resolution Applied at bfb77f4. Lane B's task guide operationalizing B072-R66: docs/README.md's six-stage map sent customer/business input to frozen docs/PRD.md 'on the demand side', conflating a request, the frozen institutional baseline, and writable derived specifications. Applied correction: customer or business input is a request until classified against the frozen Project PRD and Charter; within that baseline it refines the single derived tier owning the fact under D-29; outside it, it becomes a named Register gap or change request and drafting stops. Frozen sources are cited as evidence and are never writable intake destinations; the non-governed demand/supply labels are removed from the Request row. Unit 1 of 3 under the Judge's one-at-a-time authorization. Guide commit 77ce8a3 proves the instruction exists and is not application evidence.
nodes.rationale: graph-coverage requires every docs/ markdown file to hold a curated node. Without one, an independent reviewer cannot locate the guide that governs the correction it is reviewing.

nodes.label: B-074: R67 D-186 R21 Lifecycle Correction Guide
nodes.description: Handoff status: Answered, Resolution Applied at a2fbb21. Lane B's task guide operationalizing B072-R67: D-186's Gaps section placed B072-R21 under Unchanged while the same clause recorded that its Graphify synchronization had been performed, giving one item two mutually exclusive lifecycle states. Applied correction, appended not rewritten: the Unchanged classification is withdrawn and the effective state is Closed, evidenced at 56759ff, with the original sentence preserved as historical text. Records the separation that motivated it -- 56759ff proves historical R21 completion and is never evidence that the graph is current at a later HEAD, which is read from .graphify/branch.json against the settled HEAD. Unit 2 of 3; guide commit 18d2e79 is not application evidence.
nodes.rationale: graph-coverage requires a curated node per docs/ markdown file. This node also carries the historical-completion versus current-currency distinction, which is the reusable lesson rather than the one-off fix.

nodes.label: B-075: R68 B-072 Lifecycle-Metadata Correction Guide
nodes.description: Handoff status: Answered, Resolution Applied at b537d66, with one recorded deviation. Lane B's task guide operationalizing B072-R68: B-072 carried Verified-At-Commit 8b0fa76 while Resolution was Applied, letting historical R54 evidence read as terminal verification of the current packet, and its header still called R65-R69 closure gates. Applied: the header now carries only current state, enforcement is recorded as deferred hardening and not a closure gate per R69, and one terminal gate remains -- independent Lane B review after final Graphify synchronization. Deviation: the guide's section 2 and B075-SC1 require removing Verified-At-Commit while Applied, which closure-readiness rejects ('an applied change that names no commit cannot be re-checked'), confirmed empirically when B-073 failed that way. On the Judge's direction the field was re-pointed to the application commit and labelled an evidence anchor rather than removed; the check was not changed. RESOLVED by B-076: independent review confirmed the re-pointing is correct and superseded B075-SC1 -- while Applied, Verified-At-Commit is a REQUIRED non-terminal anchor and Verified-By is absent (B076-R1), applied at a1ad545. Unit 3 of 3; guide commit 63c51b4 is not application evidence.
nodes.rationale: graph-coverage requires a curated node per docs/ markdown file. Updated after B-076 settled the lifecycle contract, so the node no longer presents the anchor question as open.
